title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 14
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 14: the wise woman of Tekoa and Absalom's return to Jerusalem.

questions.text: From which town did Joab bring a wise woman?
questions.explanation: Joab sent to Tekoa and brought a wise woman from there.

questions.text: According to the woman's story, what happened to her two sons?
questions.explanation: She said her two sons fought together in the field, there was no one to part them, and one struck the other and killed him.

answers.text: Both of them died in battle with the Philistines
Both were taken captive by raiders from Edom
They fought in the field and one killed the other
Both left home and never came back again

questions.text: What did the king swear about the woman's son?
questions.explanation: He said, "As Yahweh lives, not one hair of your son shall fall to the earth."

answers.text: He would make her son a captain
Not one hair of her son would fall to the earth
Her son would eat at the king's table
Her son would be sent away

questions.text: To what did the woman compare people who must die?
questions.explanation: She said, "We must die, and are like water spilled on the ground, which can't be gathered up again."

questions.text: Whose hand did the king suspect was behind the woman's words?
questions.explanation: The king said, "Is the hand of Joab with you in all this?" and she admitted Joab had put the words in her mouth.

questions.text: What condition did the king set when Absalom came back?
questions.explanation: The king said, "Let him return to his own house, but let him not see my face."

answers.text: He was not to see the king's face
He was to stay in Geshur
He was to live in the king's house
He was to give up his inheritance

questions.text: How often did Absalom cut the hair of his head?
questions.explanation: It was at every year's end that he cut it, because it was heavy on him.

questions.text: What was the name of Absalom's daughter?
questions.explanation: One daughter was born to Absalom, whose name was Tamar, a woman with a beautiful face.

questions.text: What did Absalom tell his servants to set on fire?
questions.explanation: Absalom said, "Joab's field is near mine, and he has barley there. Go and set it on fire."

questions.text: What did the king do when Absalom bowed before him?
questions.explanation: Absalom bowed himself on his face to the ground before the king, and the king kissed Absalom.

answers.text: He sent him back to Geshur
He refused to look at him
